upsert.title: CAR-iNKT cell therapy for canine metastatic osteosarcoma
upsert.status: Current treatment clinical trial listed by Penn Vet Comparative Immunotherapy Program; investigator prescreen required
upsert.contacts: Penn Vet Comparative Immunotherapy Program — see official clinical-trials page
upsert.funding: Confirm current study-covered and owner-paid costs with Penn Vet.
upsert.notes: Investigational CAR-engineered invariant natural killer T-cell (CAR-iNKT) therapy for dogs with osteosarcoma metastatic to the lungs. This is distinct from conventional autologous CAR-T protocols. Full eligibility requires Penn Vet prescreening.

upsert.title: AKS-701d anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody for canine invasive urothelial carcinoma
upsert.center: Purdue University Veterinary Hospital / Werling Comparative Oncology Research Center
upsert.contacts: Purdue Veterinary Hospital / Werling Comparative Oncology Research Center — contact through Purdue current oncology clinical trials
upsert.funding: Confirm current study-covered and owner-paid costs with Purdue.
upsert.notes: NCI-funded Purdue-directed exploratory treatment trial of the caninized anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody AKS-701d in client-owned dogs with histopathologically confirmed invasive urothelial carcinoma. Public 2026 development disclosures state enrollment is ongoing; Purdue's current cancer-research page identifies the anti-cPD-L1 bladder-cancer trial as active research.
